evidence: Order #681199 ('JLC's Splatoon Brushes', $2.00) confirmed by merchant email receipt
gotchas: The country selector defaults to UK — set #billing_country=US FIRST (AJAX refresh), then #billing_state.
Fill billing with the card's billing-address tokens (not ship) or the postcode fails AVS.
Products at $0.10 are below the Stripe minimum and never mount a card frame (stripe-minimum-or-config).
Some $1.00 products render card inputs visually but expose only Stripe express/accessory frames to the SDK — not fillable; pick a normal-priced product.
